semantics.generation_outcomes: Explicit refusals, tool errors and unavailable historical outputs are separate. An unavailable output has no current PNG; historical measures belong to lost_output and do not supply a file. Explicit unavailable/error statuses override stale generated flags.
semantics.target_count: Catalogue targets, not playable characters or produced sprites.
semantics.physical_files: Only registered PNG paths that currently exist. See asset_audit.json for header and checksum validation.
semantics.stage_layers: layer_candidate_count counts distinct PNG paths; layer_candidate_ids counts declared plane IDs once per stage, regardless of revisions. Files without layer_id identify no plane. Missing IDs refer only to known contracts and remain null for unknown contracts. A candidate plane is not a validated or completed plane.
semantics.costumes: Explicit own target_ids required; base-owner artwork is never inherited.
semantics.projectiles: One target is a projectile/FX family. effect_kind distinguishes projectiles, thrown objects, instant traces, beams, impacts, areas and portals. Visual state IDs count once regardless of revisions; a file without an ID covers no specified state.
semantics.selection: Only selected_for_next_review=true counts as selected. Selection is a production decision, never a fidelity certification; historical revisions remain counted as physical files.
semantics.references: Source IDs resolve within their own catalogue namespace; roster-wide references remain labelled catalogue context. A code resource or product page does not certify a visual model.
semantics.completion: Candidate files never automatically complete fidelity, animation or stage production.
